text_blocks.snippet: A breast abscess, which is a localized collection of pus in the breast, can be mistaken for other conditions that cause breast lumps or inflammation. Differential diagnoses include mastitis, other types of breast masses (both benign and malignant), and skin infections like hidradenitis suppurativa.
